title.narrative: Financial Inclusion for Households and MSMEs in the WAEMU

description.narrative: The development objective of Financial Inclusion for Households and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in the West Africa Economic and Monetary Union (WAEMU) Project for Western and Central Africa is to increase financial inclusion for households and MSMEs in the WAEMU region. This project has three components. The first component, Access to finance by MSMEs, will be implemented by West African Development Bank (BOAD) with which the World Bank already has extensive experience through the regional projects. The second component, Housing Finance, has the following sub-components: Line of credit to increase the capacity of the West African mortgage liquidity facility (CRRH-UEMOA) to finance banks and MFIs to offer long term affordable housing loans; and Support the Regional Housing Guarantee Product. The third project component, Project Implementation support, will be managed by BOAD and will provide training and consulting services to enable BOAD to effectively implement the Project and perform the environmental, social and fiduciary bank requirements.
To promote financial inclusion and long-term finance for households and businesses in WAEMU region.
